notes.title: Huge Patch 1.2 with new maps!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone! [/b]

First of all, thanks for the huuuge feedback—reaching out to us, making YouTube videos, and discussing the game in Reddit posts. We heard you, and we want to improve our game so it will be even better for you!

[list]
[*] We added new map called "Blossom Lane Court" stylized as rural Japanese city
[*] We added new map "Beachside Court" stylized as Italian coast city
[*] We fixed major bug that caused the game to crash when playing a tie-breaker in the fifth game.
[*] We fixed major animation bug that occurred when character did very specific movement
[*] We also fixed a few minor bugs that were so rare you probably didn’t even notice them.[/list]

Thanks for staying with us, and hope that you enjoy our game and we'll be getting more feedback from you guys!

notes.title: House Fighters: Total Mess - a new upcoming project from Revulo Games!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956695/14d5478821b937dbc615c808b80239724affdf0a.png[/img]

[b]House Fighters: Total Mess [/b]is a playful arcade dogfighting game. Hop into a toy plane, zip through cozy rooms, and turn everyday objects into thrilling battlegrounds. No complicated controls, just pure, lighthearted aerial chaos. Weave between bookshelves, dodge towering lamps, and outmaneuver tiny enemies in fast-paced, feel-good combat.


[list]
[*]Weave, and strike in high-speed dogfights. Use rockets, bombs, and even household items to outmaneuver your toy-sized foes.
[*]Customize your fighter with playful stickers, wacky weapons, and unexpected upgrades. Experiment and find the perfect loadout for every mission.
[*]Chase, dodge, and loop through playful missions where every room holds a new challenge. Sneak past towering obstacles, weave through tight spaces, and take on clever little foes in fast, lighthearted dogfights.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone! [/b]

First of all, thanks for the huuuge feedback—reaching out to us, making YouTube videos, and discussing the game in Reddit posts. We heard you, and we want to improve our game so it will be even better for you!

[list]
[*]Most importantly, we fixed the AI problems that many of you mentioned. We also added a visible difficulty selection, so it's clearer for players.
[*] We added more animations to make the game feel more realistic—even when you miss your shot! :)
[*]From your feedback, we heard that interrupting your shot was unclear, and many of you didn’t even know it was in the game. So, we added it to the tutorial to make it easier to understand.
[*]We added more options for the players to turn on/off visibility of some aspects of the game.
[*]We fixed an achievement bug.
[*]We also fixed a few minor bugs that were so rare you probably didn’t even notice them.[/list]

And we're working on fixing a major bug that is causing the game to crash when playing a tie-breaker in the fifth game. It will be fixed in the upcoming patch.
